item.title: Rallying Cry – September 2, 2026
item.description: From a breakthrough urine test detecting most bladder cancers to a mathematician folding the smallest origami doughnut, plus Madrid pledging €306 million to aid Ceuta and Singapore’s last-minute rush to license 7,000 cats, today’s news is full of clever solutions and kindness.
